say:3:1320428001:0.text: It's huge, like a hundred Chippys stacked up!
say:3:1320428001:0.source_cn: 这几块石头真大啊……感觉比一百个满满加起来还要大！

say:4:1320428002:0.text: But the scent's definitely coming from behind it... If we want to know for sure, we'll have to find a way around.
say:4:1320428002:0.source_cn: 但硫磺的气味就是从这些石头后传来的。如果想搞清楚究竟是...

say:5:1320428003:0.text: But the other side is all mountains, there's no path...
say:5:1320428003:0.source_cn: 可是，另一边全都是山啊！看起来不像是有路的样子。

say:6:1320428004:0.text: Well, we can't just give up!

say:7:1320428005:0.text: Maybe we can ask Hugin for some bombs to blast through?
say:7:1320428005:0.source_cn: 唔……要不然，我们找呼金要一些炸弹，把这些石头炸掉？

choice_prompt:8:1320428005.text: Maybe we can ask Hugin for some bombs to blast through?
choice_prompt:8:1320428005.source_cn: 唔……要不然，我们找呼金要一些炸弹，把这些石头炸掉？

say:9:1320428007:0.text: All right, all right. No need to go to all that trouble.
say:9:1320428007:0.source_cn: 好啦好啦，不用这么麻烦。
say:9:1320428007:0.male: All right, all right. No need to go to all that trouble.
say:9:1320428007:0.female: All right, all right. No need to go to all that trouble.

say:10:1320428008:0.text: Sweetheart, step back. I'll take care of this stubborn rock myself.
say:10:1320428008:0.source_cn: 亲爱的，你们退后几步，让我来解决这些碍事的石头吧。

choice:8:0:1.text: Or we could climb over it.
choice:8:0:1.male: Or we could climb over it.
choice:8:0:1.female: Or we could climb over it.

say:12:1320428006:0.text: Oh, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You and Madam Gerda might manage that, but Chippy and I definitely can't!
